description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/25/02251, Dated 27/03/2026.Non Material amendment(s) Sought: Description of development to be changed to "Refurbishment of the existing facade, including re-finishing of the aluminium cladding elements, enhancements to the north entrance and introduction of a new south-west corner entrance, enhancements to street-level elevations including the addition of a living wall on part of the southern elevation, retention of Class E use including retail kiosks at ground level, erection of a single-storey roof pavilion with terrace and plant, and associated works".The application also seeks permission to; reduce the size of the roof pavilion; remove flexible restaurant use at levels 15, 16 and 17; remove conditions 7, 9 and 10 which relate to the restaurant use; amend the north facade and elevation; carry out changes to the louvres.
